incidents.name: StackMarket flash-loan driven account-token round trip
incidents.notes: StackMarket's account-token buy path could be driven with borrowed WETH and unwound through the matching Uniswap V3 pool inside one transaction, so a Morpho flash loan bought an account token and sold it straight back at a profit paid by the market.

sources.ref: onchain review: StackMarket 0x555555555a4161c1c0ba310fc1c993086d3de042 created 2024-12-07T05:35:53Z by 0x42c22ebd6f07fc052040137eeb3b8a1b7a38b275, not the attack-tx sender 0x97d8170e04771826a31c4c9b81e9f9191a1c8613; no EIP-1967 events, 91.0 days old. Classified economic-design: no code defect is identified, the pricing path simply admitted a profitable flash-loan round trip. 0.56 WETH x $2,150.20 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $1,204. Recheck (deployment basis confirmed): keccak(eth_getCode) on StackMarket is identical at the creation block 23380203 and the incident block 27309557, no EIP-1967 or beacon slot is set (slot 0 holds only the owner), and the single DELEGATECALL taken in the exploit goes to 0x83be7ba2891cd45002eff83d2836d5b9f2f6a1cf, which appears as a PUSH20 link-time library constant in the runtime and therefore cannot be repointed.
